executive_summary: The business generated €835,452.50 in total revenue with a profit of €273,352.26 and an average margin of 32.7% during 2026.

key_findings.title: Revenue Concentration
key_findings.evidence: Laptop generated €466,772.01, representing 55.9% of total revenue.
key_findings.interpretation: The business is highly dependent on Laptop sales for top-line performance.

risks.title: Transaction-Level Losses
risks.hypothesis_to_investigate: Determine whether losses are concentrated in specific products or regions.

opportunities.title: Margin Optimization
opportunities.evidence: Mouse and Keyboard margins exceed 50%, while Laptop margin is approximately 26.5%.
opportunities.action: Review product mix, pricing and cost structure using additional transaction-level analysis.

recommendations.rationale: The analysis identified transactions with negative profit that require deeper investigation.
